name: Geography Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public geographic data.

entries.title: US Census Bureau TIGER/Line Shapefiles
entries.description: The Census Bureau's annual extracts of its MAF/TIGER geographic database: legal and statistical boundaries (states, counties, county subdivisions, places, tracts, block groups, blocks, congressional and legislative districts, ZCTAs, PUMAs and more), roads, rail, hydrography and landmarks, with the geographic codes that join to Census data. The standard boundary files behind US statistics.

coverage.spatial: United States, Puerto Rico and Island Areas (nation down to census block)
coverage.temporal: 2007-present as shapefiles (2026 edition latest); ASCII TIGER/Line for 2006 and earlier

entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-11-01: HTTP 200 (curl; content read with headless Chromium). The page lists "Shapefile - 2007 to Present" and "TIGER/Line ASCII format - 2006 and earlier" and says "The core TIGER/Line Files and Shapefiles do not include demographic data, but they do contain geographic entity codes that can be linked to the Census Bureau’s demographic data". Latest: "2026 TIGER/Line Shapefiles ... All legal boundaries and names are as of January 1, 2026. The 2026 TIGER/Line Shapefiles were released on October 14, 2026", with Download, Web Interface and FTP Archive links.
Licence checked 2026-11-01: no data-specific licence statement was found. The Census open-data page (https://www.census.gov/topics/research/research-transparency-public-access/open-data.html) says the Bureau shares "its public data as open data" under OMB open data policy, but does not use the words "public domain". The public-domain status rests on the Census Bureau being a federal agency (17 U.S.C. §105), which is how other Census entries in this workspace record it. Not checked: the geodatabase and KML cartographic boundary products (a separate series), or the TIGERweb services.

entries.title: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service CORINE Land Cover
entries.description: Pan-European land cover and land use inventory in 44 thematic classes, produced for reference years 1990, 2000, 2006, 2012 and 2018 with change layers between them, at a 25 ha minimum mapping unit. The standard harmonised land cover base for Europe, run by the European Environment Agency under the EU's Copernicus programme.
entries.publisher: European Environment Agency, Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (European Union)

access.auth_note: Downloads go through an "Add to cart" flow next to a Register/Login link; a free CLMS account is likely needed but this was not tested.

entries.license: Copernicus full, free and open data policy (Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 1159/2013; source attribution required)
entries.attribution: European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service information
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-11-01: HTTP 200 (curl; content read with headless Chromium). The product page says CLC "offers a pan-European land cover and land use inventory with 44 thematic classes" and "is updated with new status and change layers every six years—with the most recent update made in 2018"; datasets listed are CLC 2018, 2012, 2006, 2000, 1990 plus change layers. The CLC 2018 download tab offers pre-packaged Europe files (version v2020_20u1): 100 m raster GeoTIFF (125 MB), vector GDB (5 GB) and GPKG (4 GB), plus WMS, REST API and a CLMS download API. The DOI recorded is the one for the CLC 2018 raster; the vector DOI is 10.2909/71c95a07-e296-44fc-b22b-415f42acfdf0. No CLC 2024 release was listed on the page.
Licence checked 2026-11-01: https://land.copernicus.eu/en/data-policy states "The Copernicus land monitoring products and services are made available on a principle of full, open and free access, as established by the Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 1159/2013", on condition that users "inform the public of the source", state any modification, and do not imply EU endorsement. This is a data-specific policy, not a CC licence. Not checked: whether login is actually required to download, the API itself, or the overlap with the eea-datahub entry in environment-almanac (which is a general EEA hub, not this product).

entries.title: Copernicus DEM (GLO-30, GLO-90 and EEA-10 Digital Elevation Model)
entries.description: Global digital surface model derived from the TanDEM-X mission (2011-2015), distributed by the European Space Agency under the EU Copernicus programme at 30 m and 90 m worldwide (GLO-30, GLO-90) and 10 m over 39 European countries (EEA-10). The most widely used open global elevation baseline after SRTM.
entries.publisher: European Space Agency (ESA), Copernicus Contributing Missions, via the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem

access.auth_note: Free Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem registration required; general public may download GLO-30 and GLO-90 only, EEA-10 download is limited to eligible users (public authorities, EU institutions, EU-funded research, etc.).

coverage.temporal: TanDEM-X acquisitions 2011-2015 (older DEMs used for gap fill)

entries.license: ESA User Licence for Copernicus DEM (GLO-30 and GLO-90 free worldwide with mandatory © DLR/Airbus notice; EEA-10 restricted)
entries.attribution: © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-11-01: HTTP 200 (curl; content read with headless Chromium). The collection page describes "a Digital Surface Model (DSM) that represents the surface of the Earth including buildings, infrastructure and vegetation" in "3 different instances: EEA-10, GLO-30 and GLO-90", says "Nine releases are currently available", and that the datasets "were made available for use in 2019 and will be maintained until 2026" (worth re-checking after 2026). Access is via the Copernicus Browser, API, and bulk download "via S3-compatible object storage and OData API using temporary credentials". This is a DSM, not a bare-earth terrain model.
Licence checked 2026-11-01: the same page, under "Licensing and citation guidelines", states "The GLO-30 and GLO-90 datasets are available worldwide with a free license" and requires the notice "© DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved" (with "produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 ..." for modified data). EEA-10 access follows the "ESA-User license for the use of CCM data and CCM Data Access Restrictions". The full ESA User Licence text was not read. Not checked: the release list, the formats beyond the dataset IDs (DTED, DGED, INSPIRE), and copies hosted elsewhere (e.g. public cloud mirrors).

entries.title: Eurostat GISCO Geodata (NUTS, LAU, countries, communes and other reference layers)
entries.description: Eurostat's Geographic Information System of the Commission (GISCO) distributes the EU's reference geographies: NUTS regions, local administrative units (LAU), communes, countries, postal codes, census and coastal units, cities and functional urban areas, plus grids, transport networks, land cover and elevation layers. NUTS and LAU are the boundary sets that EU regional statistics are published against.

coverage.spatial: EU member states and EFTA/candidate countries (varies by layer); countries layer is global
coverage.temporal: varies by layer (multiple NUTS and LAU vintages)

entries.license: proprietary-noncommercial for boundary layers (GISCO administrative and statistical units copyright clauses; © EuroGeographics); other layers under Eurostat copyright and licence policy
entries.attribution: © EuroGeographics for the administrative boundaries; Eurostat GISCO
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-11-01: HTTP 200 (curl; content read with headless Chromium). The Geodata page lists Administrative units, Statistical units, Population distribution, Grids, Transport networks, Basic services, Geographic accessibility, Land cover and Digital elevation model, and states "All datasets are provided with their metadata in XML format ... Geographical datasets are provided in a variety of formats." Page footer "Last page update: 11 June 2025". The Statistical units page lists Census, Coastal, LAU, NUTS and Cities and functional urban areas.
Licence checked 2026-11-01: the Administrative units page (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/gisco/geodata/administrative-units) and Statistical units page (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/gisco/geodata/statistical-units) both state that the right to use the data is granted on condition that "the data will not be used for commercial purposes" and that the notice "© EuroGeographics for the administrative boundaries" is shown; "If you intend to use the data commercially, please contact EuroGeographics". The Geodata page says otherwise "Eurostat's general copyright notice and licence policy applies" with "specific rules" for some datasets. These are data-specific terms. Not checked: the licence of the grid, transport, land cover and elevation layers individually; exact download formats (only the XML metadata statement was seen); the GISCO distribution API.
